claim: Theorem 5 (certified-feasibility guide generation): enumerate the 4^7 guide seeds and report the certified-feasible yield (U <= tau and predicted efficacy >= eta).

assumptions.tau: certified off-target threshold, swept as multiples of the parent D1's U ((0.5, 0.75, 1.0)); U(D1)=144.3450
assumptions.eta: predicted on-target efficacy threshold, swept over (0.6, 0.7, 0.8)
assumptions.dg_input: RESPONSIVE seed-duplex dG input: e_seed[g] = (count of the seed's cognate 3'UTR site in gene g) * occupancy(seed), occupancy = -min(dG,0) from ViennaRNA duplexfold; NOT a site count.
assumptions.certified_U: U = ||P_alpha(S)||_2 * ||e_seed||_2, a certified upper bound on the GRN-propagated off-target ||P_alpha(S) e_seed|| over mouse TRRUST.
assumptions.gna_caveat: ViennaRNA has no GNA sugar parameters, so the position-7 (S)-GNA of D4 is modeled as a g7 Watson-Crick mismatch (A->C) against the D1 site; this is an explicit destabilization model (an upper bound on the true GNA penalty).
assumptions.efficacy_model: Huesken-trained ridge on the K=9 CASCADE features; sequence-based, so it cannot distinguish D1 from D4 (same base sequence). Train R2=0.347.

D4.gna_model: g7 A->C mismatch vs the D1 site
